🍗Learning how to Cook => Chicken Masala 🤤 🥣 Step 1: Prep & Marinate 1) Wash the chicken pieces thoroughly with water. 2) Mix the chicken in a bowl with ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric (haldi), red chilli powder, and most important salt (save some little spices). 3) Rest the chicken in the bowl for 10 minutes so the flavours sink into the meat. 🍳 Step 2: Fry the Vegetables & Spices 1) Chop 2 onions into slices and cut 2 potatoes into long pieces.Tip: Keep the onion quantity close to the chicken weight (e.g., 70g of onions for every 100g of chicken). 2) Heat oil in your pressure cooker. 3) Fry the chopped onions and potatoes together until they turn a light golden yellow 🟡. 4) Add remaining spices mix it well & then add marinated chicken into the cooker. 5) Stir-fry everything together well for 2 to 3 minutes (till chicken cover with spices). 6) Take a regular plate pore water on it and Cover the cooker (do not lock the cooker lid yet). 7) After Pouring water onto the top of this plate. Cook on high heat for 5 minutes until bubbles form in the water on the plate.Pour that hot water from the plate directly into the cooker. (Add just enough so the water level matches the height of the chicken.) 💨 Step 3: Pressure Cook 1) Lock the pressure cooker lid securely in place. 2) Cook on high heat until the cooker blows 8 whistles. 3) Lower the heat and let it cook for 9 to 10 more whistles, then turn off the stove. 4) Wait for 15 minutes. Do not force the lid open; let the steam escape naturally. 🍽️ Your delicious Chicken Masala is now ready to eat!
